TokenWarp.SpeedOverridden: Nik's Token Motion sets the movement speed while its Movement Style isn't Foundry default, so this setting and the per-actor speed overrides have no effect.

MovementStyle.Name: Movement Style
MovementStyle.Hint: How tokens move. Step: hops one grid space at a time like a miniature (flying and jumping tokens, gridless scenes and very long moves use Lift & Place). Lift & Place: lifted, carried and set down like a chess piece. Glide: speeds up and slows down smoothly.

ApplyTo.Name: Apply To
ApplyTo.Hint: Which moves use the movement style. Keyboard moves are short and repeated quickly, so they usually feel better at Foundry's default speed.

TopSpeed.Name: Top Speed (grid spaces per second)
TopSpeed.Hint: The fastest a token moves on long moves. Foundry's default constant speed is 6.

Acceleration.Name: Acceleration (grid spaces per second²)
Acceleration.Hint: How quickly tokens speed up and slow down. Higher values feel snappier; lower values feel heavier.

MaxDuration.Name: Maximum Move Duration (seconds)
MaxDuration.Hint: Very long moves are sped up so they never take longer than this. 0 means no limit.

HopDuration.Name: Hop Duration (milliseconds)
HopDuration.Hint: Step style: how long one hop to the next grid space takes, including the short rest. Long moves use shorter hops to stay within the maximum move duration.

LiftHeight.Name: Lift Height (%)
LiftHeight.Hint: Lift & Place, Step and dragging: how much bigger a lifted token looks. 0 turns lifting off.

Shadow.Name: Shadow Under Lifted Tokens
Shadow.Hint: A soft shadow stays on the table below a lifted token.

Terrain.Name: Slow Down in Difficult Terrain
Terrain.Hint: Tokens move slower through difficult terrain, as they do without this module.

PreviewSmoothing.Name: Drag Preview Smoothing
PreviewSmoothing.Hint: The token you drag glides between grid spaces instead of jumping. This only changes how the preview looks to you.

Reset.Name: Reset to Defaults
Reset.Hint: Fills in the default values for this module's settings. Click Save Changes to apply them.
Reset.Info: Nik's Token Motion defaults filled in. Click Save Changes to apply them.
